name: hfc_failed_plant_action_rerca
label: Failed plant action, re-RCA, and MR update
description: A first Dirty Boots repair does not restore service; the same incident and jTrack MR return to RCA before a second plant attempt succeeds.

evidence.subject: CM-9001
evidence.summary: The modem shows severe upstream impairment and uncorrectable codewords.

evidence.subject: TAP-ARE-09-04
evidence.summary: Clean Boots evidence places the fault at or beyond the HFC tap.

deterministic_rca.cause: RF measurements localize the impairment beyond the customer-resolvable domain at the HFC tap.

llm_rca.cause: The tap-side measurements and codeword pattern support a plant-domain impairment.

post_failure_rca.cause: The first plant action did not clear the original RF signature; new measurements justify an updated MR and second targeted attempt.

expected_outcome: The first plant attempt fails, new evidence forces re-RCA, the existing MR is updated rather than duplicated, and the second attempt closes after verification.
true_domain_basis: MR updated rather than abandoned; tap was correct, execution failed
